name: Ultracare Keranet Easy Spray
description: UltraCare Keranet Easy is the ready to use half of the Keranet pair: a 3 percent acid solution at pH 1.4 in a 750 ml trigger bottle, where UltraCare Keranet is a concentrate diluted 1 part to 5 or 10 parts water. Nothing to measure, so it suits touch up work and the moment straight after grouting. Once the grout has lost its plasticity and gone opaque, spray, leave it to react for 1 to 2 minutes, then work a damp cellulose sponge diagonally across the joints. On large formats that is what prevents the picture frame of residue around each tile, and the same spray cleans the back of tiles before they are laid. The acid is inorganic, so it lifts cement scum and efflorescence without hydrochloric fumes, but it is still acid: never on polished marble, limestone or cementitious terrazzo. One litre cleans up to 10 m2.
meta_description: Ultracare Keranet Easy Spray TDS: ready to use acid cleaner for cement residue, 750 ml spray, 1 litre cleans 10 m2. Data sheet from Lapiz Blue UAE.

specs.dilution: ready to use, supplied as a 3% aqueous solution, no dilution required
specs.reaction_time: leave to react for 1 to 2 minutes, then sponge

applications: Removing fresh cementitious grout residue immediately after grouting
Removing light cured grout residue the day after grouting
Cleaning the back of porcelain tiles before they are laid
Preventing the frame effect when installing large format tiles
Removing cement, lime and efflorescence from porcelain, ceramic, glass mosaic, quarry tile and terracotta
Cleaning indoor and outdoor acid resistant natural stone
